comment: SN2: 0x80-0x8F e 0xE0: pausa b+1 ticks (confirmado)

name: snd_cmd_transpose
comment: SN2: E8 xx com sinal -> +0x6A (confirmado)

name: snd_cmd_E9
comment: SN2: E9 xx -> +0x6B = min(xx,0x30) (confirmado, sem GUESS)

name: snd_cmd_F7
comment: SN2: F7 xx -> +0x54 (0 -> 8); flag 0x08 em +0x50 (confirmado)

name: snd_cmd_F8
comment: SN2: F8 xx -> +0x55 = deslocamento de altura somado a freq (confirmado)

name: snd_cmd_envelope
comment: SN2: FB a b c d -> +0x5B..0x5E; +0x62=1; reset de fase se sub-modo<3 (chama Bar_ResetPhase1: nome suspeito)

name: snd_cmd_FC
comment: SN2: FC -> +0x62=1; mesmo ramo de reset de FB

name: snd_cmd_FD
comment: SN2: FD -> +0x62=0; mesmo ramo de reset de FB

name: snd_cmd_mode
comment: SN2: FE xx -> +0x63 = modo da nota (0 normal; 1 operando extra; 2 duracao em +0x28) (confirmado)

name: snd_cmd_end
comment: SN2: FF = snd_track_stop_callback (confirmado)

name: snd_track_stop_callback
comment: SN2: se cursor(+0x14)!=0: snd_track_reset_state e callback +0x0C (confirmado)

name: Snd_StopCallback_ResetCall
comment: SN2: unico chamador de snd_track_reset_state (confirmado)

name: snd_update_frame
comment: SN2: ordem: trilhas, ch1..4, grupos A/B, snd_ring_write de trilhas 0..2, snd_master_ctrl_write (confirmado)

name: snd_channel_update_1
comment: SN2: CH1 regs 0x60 (FUN_080732C8), 0x62/0x65 (reg_value), 0x64 freq; nota: note_write(0x62,0x64)

name: snd_channel_update_2
comment: SN2: CH2 regs 0x68/0x6D, freq 0x6C; nota: note_write(0x68,0x6C)

name: snd_channel_update_3
comment: SN2: CH3 vol 0x72 (SOUND3CNT_H), freq 0x74; nota: note_write(0x72,0x74)

name: snd_channel_update_4
comment: SN2: CH4 env 0x78 (FUN_080733BC), noise 0x7C (FUN_080734F4); sempre ctrl_write

name: snd_channel_ctrl_write
comment: SN2: escreve 0x04000081 (byte alto de SOUNDCNT_L) com mascara da tabela 0x083ABBF2/0x083ABBF6; nivel = +0x6F (EA) ou 3 se [drv+0x72C]&4 (confirmado)

name: snd_channel_freq_write_a
comment: SN2: freq = clamp(+0x46 + +0x55 + (+0x38>>4), 0, 0x7FF); bit 0x8000 gatilho (confirmado)

name: snd_channel_note_write
comment: SN2: le nota do anel (snd_ring_read); -1 = soltar; freq = snd_freq_lookup + +0x55, clamp 0x7FF (confirmado)

name: snd_hw_init
comment: SN2: 0x04000084=0x80; 0x04000082=0x400E; 0x04000070=0xC0; snd_hw_channel_reset(0); snd_cmd_push(7,7) (confirmado)

name: snd_dma_channel_setup

name: Snd_FifoAddrTable
comment: SN2: tabela de enderecos de FIFO (0x040000A0/A4), via pool de snd_dma_channel_setup (provavel)

name: snd_sfx_start
comment: SN2: ptr = [driver+0x68C][id*4] sem limite; prio: track+0x6D <= prio (confirmado)

name: snd_pcm_rate_set
